\section*{AP \({ }^{\text {® }}\) CALCULUS AB \\ 2008 SCORING GUIDELINES (Form B)}

\section*{Question 1}

Let \(R\) be the region in the first quadrant bounded by the graphs of \(y=\sqrt{x}\) and \(y=\frac{x}{3}\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the area of \(R\).
\item[(b)] Find the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is rotated about the vertical line \(x=-1\).
\item[(c)] The region \(R\) is the base of a solid. For this solid, the cross sections perpendicular to the \(y\)-axis are squares. Find the volume of this solid.
\end{itemize}

The graphs of \(y=\sqrt{x}\) and \(y=\frac{x}{3}\) intersect at the points \((0,0)\) and \((9,3)\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] \(\int_{0}^{9}\left(\sqrt{x}-\frac{x}{3}\right) d x=4.5\)
OR
\[
\int_{0}^{3}\left(3 y-y^{2}\right) d y=4.5
\]
\item[(b)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \pi \int_{0}^{3}\left((3 y+1)^{2}-\left(y^{2}+1\right)^{2}\right) d y \\
& \quad=\frac{207 \pi}{5}=130.061 \text { or } 130.062
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(c)] \(\int_{0}^{3}\left(3 y-y^{2}\right)^{2} d y=8.1\)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { limits } \\ 1: \text { integrand } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(4:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { constant and limits } \\ 2: \text { integrand } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { integrand } \\ 1: \text { limits and answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
